verdict.rationale: AFK documents goal decomposition into task graphs with parallel branches and a single surface for querying and acting across connected tools. None of this describes selecting many items and applying one action to all of them at once. Parallel step execution and cross-tool access are adjacent orchestration features, not a documented bulk-operations capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
